### Added
- Add a `policies.kyverno.io/v1` PolicyException next to the `kyverno.io/v2` one, so the exception also applies to the CEL (ValidatingPolicy) versions of the policies. The CEL one is always rendered; set `kyvernoPolicyExceptions.legacy.enabled: false` to stop rendering the legacy one.
- Label the `kyverno.io/v2` PolicyExceptions with `policy.giantswarm.io/migrated-to-cel: "true"`, to mark them as migrated to CEL.
### Changed
- Scrape Falco and Falcosidekick with two ServiceMonitors each, so that their security metrics go to the security tenant and all other metrics to the default tenant.
- Add a `node` label to all Falco metrics.
- Set the `giantswarm` observability tenant explicitly on the k8s-metacollector ServiceMonitor.
- Move the PolicyExceptions from the `giantswarm` namespace to `kube-system` (`kyvernoPolicyExceptions.namespace`), as the `giantswarm` namespace is going away.
- set size limits for emptyDir volumes
- Updated `falco` to upstream version `v0.45.1`.
- Updated `k8s-metacollector` to upstream version `v0.1.5`.
- Updated `charts` to upstream version `falco-9.2.1`.
- Updated `falco` to upstream version `v0.45.2`.
- Updated `charts` to upstream version `falco-9.2.2`.
- Falco, Falcosidekick (including the optional web UI, its Redis and the `helm test` Pod) and k8s-metacollector tolerate the `kubernetes.io/arch=arm64:NoSchedule` taint of Giant Swarm arm64 node pools. The Falco DaemonSet now covers arm64 nodes with runtime detection, and the other components can be scheduled there.
### Fixed
- Allow Falco to reach Falcosidekick in namespaces with a default-deny network policy, so that a timing out HTTP output no longer holds back Falco's other outputs.
- Allow metrics to be scraped from Falcosidekick and k8s-metacollector in namespaces with a default-deny network policy.
